lines.text: Work hard for a long time.
I'm grinding to reach level fifty.

data.mean: Work hard for a long time.
data.define: To keep working at something to improve or earn.

example.text: I'm grinding to reach level fifty.

misuse.text: Don't call your boss's meeting 'the grind' aloud.
misuse.why: It sounds like you hate work.
